title: Baga Beach Parasailing & Water Sports Combo
description: High-adrenaline combo including tandem parasailing, jet ski, banana boat, and bumper ride with certified life jackets.

title: Grand Island Scuba Diving & Dolphin Sight
description: PADI-assisted beginner scuba dive with underwater video and boat transfer to Grande Island.

title: Morning Ghats Rowboat & Subah-e-Banaras
description: Sunrise boat glide from Assi Ghat to Manikarnika Ghat with an experienced local boatman.

title: Evening VIP Bajra Boat for Ganga Aarti
description: Front-row river seating facing Dashashwamedh Ghat during the grand Maha Aarti ceremony.

title: Amber Fort & Royal Sheesh Mahal Heritage Guide
description: Govt-licensed heritage storyteller detailing Mughal-Rajput battle history and mirror palace secrets.

title: Pink City Old Haveli Architecture & Food Walk
description: Sample pyaz kachori at Rawat Mishtan, MI Road lassi, ghewar sweets, and walk through secret stepwells.

title: Taj Mahal Sunrise & Mehtab Bagh Expert Tour
description: Skip crowds at first light; explore pietra dura marble inlay secrets and Mughal garden geometry.

title: Alleppey Backwater Kayaking & Village Canal Tour
description: Paddle through serene narrow canals inaccessible to houseboats, accompanied by an expert naturalist.

title: Old Delhi Shahjahanabad Rickshaw & Spice Trail
description: Cycle rickshaw ride through Khari Baoli Asia's largest spice market, Paranthe Wali Gali, and Jama Masjid.

title: Sunset Camel Safari & Thar Desert Folk Night
description: Dune bashing, camel trek to sunset point, live campfire Kalbeliya folk dance with hot bajra rotis.
